cases.case_label: Full-length MATR3 variant 5 processed pseudogene inserted on chr12 near LHX5
cases.mechanism_detail: A retrotransposed full-length cDNA of MATR3 transcript variant 5 (seen on the panel as an apparent exon 15 duplication) is inserted on chromosome 12, ~20 kb upstream of LHX5, flanked by 15-bp repeats; it is also carried by an unaffected parent and grandparent, so it may be a reduced-penetrance cause or benign. No expression or functional effect was demonstrated.
cases.quote: This suggests that the mutation is either a disease-causing mutation with incomplete penetrance, which has been observed in heritable FTD, or a benign variant.
